items.title: Temenos selected by Raya Financing
items.snippet: Temenos (SIX: TEMN), a global leader in banking technology, today announced that Raya Financing has selected Temenos Core to power the next phase of its growth strategy.

items.title: Survey suggests UK innovation is moving abroad
items.snippet: Almost eight in ten (78%) FTSE firms have moved innovation investment or activity overseas in the past three years, according to new research from innovation incentives consultancy ForrestBrown.

items.title: HKEX launches AI and semiconductor indices
items.snippet: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) is pleased to announce today (Friday) the launch of the HKEX Artificial Intelligence Index and the HKEX Semiconductor Index.

items.title: Visa partners with Singapore Tourism Board
items.snippet: Visa, a global leader in digital payments and the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) have signed a three-year Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to strengthen Singapore’s appeal as a preferred travel destination and to unlock new growth opportunities.

items.title: Cognitive Credit raises $40m to scale specialist data and AI for credit markets
